Verify the larger PD2 child stability loss and locate any subsequent -1 crossing; a negative outside multiplier alone does not classify it.

Refine the remaining parameter-turn candidates; a plotted turn is not a validated fold.
Continue H2 and resolve global connections of the Hopf-born and stable burst families.
Torus-to-saddle-cycle proximity does not establish the connecting invariant manifolds or stable irregular bursting.
Spatial correspondence at one working point does not establish native SNN temporal equivalence.
Complete independent full-state critical-mode checks for legacy BVP-located LPC markers; marker counts are not uniformly validated counts.
followup_actions: Four 1024-to-2048 secondary-fold refinements with continuous-defect checks
110 additional Hopf-born and 70 additional A-leading cycle continuation points
Checkpointed full-state and delay-history Floquet survey; unfinished

fold_mode_check_scope: Parameter-location convergence and full variational-mode convergence are distinct. Review step and orbit-mesh refinements together; no blanket mode-convergence claim.

full_stationary_root_count_coverage.scope: Argument-principle counts of the full rate characteristic determinant at sampled equilibria. All tail frequencies bounded; interior contour resolution numerical. Equal counts at two offsets do not prove the narrow strip is empty, or exclude paired crossings between parameter sites.

stationary_inventory_balance.meaning: Lower bound conditional on the resolved contour counts and generic known crossings. A deficit is missing crossings or a numerical inconsistency, never an automatically named Hopf. Zero deficit does not exclude cancelling crossings. Fold branch positions use nearest full regional equilibrium and lie well inside the listed count intervals.

nonlinear_departure.interpretation: Weak oscillations with relative-phase drift; no large-burst transition in this finite run.
